The planner uses sparse shallow embossed divisions only, no letters, numbers, dates, symbols or checkmarks. Understated high-end product-launch art direction, tactile and architectural, clean rather than childish, no neon glow, no glassmorphism UI, no floating interface cards, no sparkles, no confetti, no people, no photographic backgrounds, no gradients in the backdrop, no stock imagery, no logo or text. Clearly separated shapes and subtle shading, polished illustration-quality rendering with excellent small-size legibility. Compose as one cohesive balanced object cluster centered, fill about 82 percent of a wide 3:2 canvas, leave transparent breathing room all around; nothing cropped. True transparent background, only restrained contact shadows immediately beneath objects; it must look excellent when placed on a deep cobalt website panel. This is decorative art, no verified work status is implied.
